title: Accept the NORMALIZE-01 migration model and recommended defaults

admissibility.ordering_limitation: The user selected the explicitly recommended ACCEPT-DEFAULTS token before the durable four-option prefilter request and receipt were materialized. The receipt proves structural admissibility and does not claim that every receipt option label was displayed before selection.

selection.selected_by: CyberAlchemy Lab definition-migration owner via exact user reply
selection.rationale: Accept the validated NORMALIZE-01 model as the migration planning baseline and resolve its five open questions using the recommended defaults.

resolved_defaults.question: Which owner scopes become DDD Bounded Contexts?
resolved_defaults.selection: Do not infer any; select each with language, scope, exclusions, owner, and directional maps.
resolved_defaults.effect: Owner scopes remain independent classification records. Context directories and maps remain blocked until an explicit owner selection.

resolved_defaults.question: Should the generic evaluation envelope use one schema plus profiles or separate subtype schemas?
resolved_defaults.selection: One envelope with owner-local subtype schemas bound through exact profiles.
resolved_defaults.effect: Shared evaluation mechanics may be designed once, while each domain meaning retains an exact owner-local profile and subtype schema.

resolved_defaults.question: Which normalized artifact type is the first admitted vertical witness?
resolved_defaults.selection: Definition/v1 because all later semantic artifacts depend on its voice and projection contract.
resolved_defaults.effect: Definition/v1 is selected as the next candidate vertical; this sequence choice is not artifact-type admission or implementation authorization.

resolved_defaults.question: Where will durable owner decisions for D1-D69 be recorded?
resolved_defaults.selection: Create one immutable normalization decision bound to this JSON digest after review.
resolved_defaults.effect: This immutable decision records acceptance of the exact NORMALIZE-01 planning model and its D1-D69 outcomes; changed candidate bytes require a new review and decision.

resolved_defaults.question: Which legacy DS identifiers remain active aliases after the Craft rename?
resolved_defaults.selection: Preserve identifiers initially as lineage aliases; change display names without identity churn.
resolved_defaults.effect: Craft migration must preserve legacy DomainSpec identifiers as explicit lineage aliases until a later owner decision retires them.

normalization_result.effect: The exact NORMALIZE-01 model and five defaults are selected as the definition-migration planning baseline.

non_effects: The accepted normalization and validation bytes remain immutable; this decision does not rewrite them.

successor_blockers: Definition/v1 requires a separately bounded candidate-authoring action under the selected definition route.

Each DDD Bounded Context requires an explicit selection of language, scope, exclusions, owner, and directional context maps.
Craft alias retirement requires a later owner decision; this decision only preserves aliases during initial migration.
